test_title: PYST 66: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
In the question four alternatives are given for the underlined word in the sentence. Choose the alternative which best expresses the opposite meaning of the word.

We __embraced__ each other overjoyed at our success, then I took photograph of Tenzing holding aloft the flags of Great Britain, Nepal, the United Nations and India.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"embraced"** means to hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection. (गले लगाना)

 
 
• **Example: **They** embraced** each other warmly after a long time apart.
 
 
 
• **"Limited"** means restricted in size, amount, or extent. (सीमित)
 
 
• **Example: **His opportunities were **limited** by his lack of education.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'embraced'** is **'limited'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cradled **(पालना): To hold gently and protectively.

 
 
• **Example:** She cradled the baby in her arms.
 
 
 
• **Junked **(फेंक दिया): To discard or abandon as useless or obsolete.
 
 
• **Example: **They junked the old car after it broke down.
 
 
 
• **Contained** (शामिल): To have or hold within.
 
 
• **Example:** The box contained various tools and supplies.

The correct answer is: Option 1.&
